text:
The plate is roughly 26 cm across and spans about 440 px in the image, so about 17 px per cm.

There are two corn cob slices. Each is about 70-80 px across, which is roughly 4.3 cm, and about 2 cm thick. That gives a volume of about π × 2.15² × 2 ≈ 29 cm³ per slice. Allowing for the cob core, each slice weighs about 25 g, so the two together come to about 50 g. A few loose kernels add a little more, bringing the total to about 50 g.
